title: Crown Overview Tools
description: Crown Overview Tools 1.1.29 adds player-editable character identity/roleplay details (Culture, Religion/Faith, age, physical description, preferred weapons, marriage/children, and public notes) while keeping mechanical stats, House, ownership, location, traits/quirks, and GM notes protected. Includes v1.1.28 private strategic-action chat and v1.1.27 political-overlay fixes.
